results.source_finding: The complete continuous Gregem prayer is printed at Feltoe p.42 lines8-10/PDF66; the same edition Addenda and Corrigenda/PDF24 explicitly changes Pater to Pastor. This is a corrected critical printed witness, not a claim to a manuscript diplomatic transcription. The prayer precedes the XIIII Item alia heading.
delta_verified: Plural beatos apostolos becomes the exact named singular recipient and office; Clement and Zephyrinus include Martyrem tuum atque, Sylvester does not.
quos/pastores become quem/pastorem and Filii tui vicarios is removed.
The historical per. is distinct from the exact target conclusion; pointing, case, accents and linewrap are normalized as declared.
results.english_finding: The successor keeps the gracious regard and protection of the flock, exact saint/rank and appointment as shepherd of the whole Church. Its whom you appointed relative clause directly represents quem. Revised object placement is clear, and the printed conclusion is still rendered at its actual length without expansion.

results.source_finding: Feltoe p.131 lines1-3/PDF155 has the complete continuous Ecclesiam tuam prayer. Its Domine is a printed abbreviation, expanded explicitly in the source passage record. Mame1922 p.254/PDF368 has the contiguous conventional Latin formula that includes every word through the Clement target stop in unitate; the source continues beyond that stop.
delta_verified: Move Domine from after Ecclesiam tuam to before Ecclesiam tuam.
inlumina becomes illumina; accent, case, pointing and linewrap normalization are separate from lexical additions.

Feltoe ends per.; Clement actually prints Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate. Mame independently witnesses this contiguous formula prefix, with routine orthographic/pointing differences; no later formula words are supplied.
results.actual_target_conclusion: Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.
results.english_finding: Offered gifts, supplication, gracious illumination of the Church, progress of the flock everywhere, and shepherds pleasing to the divine name under divine governance are represented without an added petition. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you in unity corresponds to the actual printed target ending. It adds no Holy Spirit, God or age formula beyond in unitate.

results.source_finding: Feltoe p.132 lines9-11/PDF156 supplies one continuous Guberna prayer before XI Item alia. The complete governing prayer and arrangement are visible, but the sacramental opening in the Clement target is absent from Feltoe.
delta_verified: Change Guberna Domine quaesumus to guberna quaesumus Domine.
Expand printed Domine abbreviation in the historical transcription and distinguish its per. from actual target Per Dominum.; normalize typography as declared.
results.english_finding: The Church nourished by holy refreshment, gracious governance, direction by powerful rule, growth in freedom and persistence in religious integrity are faithfully represented. Grow in freedom conveys incrementa libertatis accipiat. Through the Lord preserves the actual cue with no invented long ending.

urban_negative.bounded_conclusion: No complete older matching Urban whole arrangement has been established in the received packet. Related old fragments and a shared modern invocation do not establish that full target. This is a source/rights gap on the present record, not proof that no earlier source exists and not a finding of infringement.
urban_negative.scope_limit: No Urban target body or English supplied for publication; no new corpus-wide absence claim; Feltoe related-preface page itself not freshly reviewed here because the verified own/Common mismatch and absence of a complete offered witness suffice for this bounded hold.
